requested_outcome: From Attractions and every public VII page, the header search opens the real world chooser immediately, preserves the current-world context, and never redirects to an unrelated vacation-only search.
natural_destination: The header search and world chooser on /attractions, /trails and representative pages from every public world, before and after hydration, on desktop and mobile.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, implement, test, commit and prepare the existing VII site release. Public deployment remains a separate action-time confirmed step.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared header defect requires visible end-to-end proof across the affected page family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise the exact header action before and after hydration, on desktop and mobile, and verify a real cross-world destination.

lesson_bundle.reason: The broken control claims global search but sends visitors into a different search corpus.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Remove misleading global-search behavior and keep world choice, route, active context and destination aligned.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested repair is focused on search navigation and must preserve the approved header and page layout.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: No unrelated redesign, catalog, filter, page-order or content change is allowed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The header currently offers a misleading extra search path in addition to the world choices.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Present one immediate decision, choose the search world, while preserving access to each real world.

lesson_bundle.reason: The repaired shared navigation is intended for the public VII site.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Release only the exact verified commit, preserve rollback identity and recheck the public routes after deployment.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The search still jumps to /search when clicked before React hydration.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use an immediately interactive native disclosure whose real world links exist in server HTML.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The first rendered HTML contains the closed chooser and no pre-hydration /search fallback.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Attractions or trails cannot be recognized as the active world.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Derive the navigation context from the current pathname for the two activity sub-worlds.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The matching item is active on /attractions and /trails and the other item remains available.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The menu looks fixed locally but fails on mobile or a low-height screen.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise the native chooser at desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low height, including open, close, Escape and world navigation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The chooser remains fully reachable and leaves no stale overlay or body lock.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A broad header rewrite damages other public worlds.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the existing panel design and link model, change only the activation mechanism and truthful choice set, then run the full shared-header family suite.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative vacation, events, spa, hourly, providers, trails and attractions routes retain a working header chooser.

affected_family: Vacation, events, corporate, spa, hourly and providers routes

sources.label: VII search and world consistency standard
Observed attractions header and local-search layout

midpoint_gate.trigger: The first server-rendered attractions page after replacing the pre-hydration fallback.
checks: The header control opens without changing the URL before hydration.
The panel contains only real world destinations and marks Attractions active.
Selecting another world reaches its real route.

attack_questions: Can a first-paint click still navigate to vacation search?
Can Attractions or Trails open the menu without an active current item?
Can opening, closing or resizing leave the chooser hidden, stuck or off-screen?
Does any public world lose access to another world?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Observed browser interaction on the exact release candidate and then the deployed /attractions page.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated shared-header contracts plus representative browser checks across all world route families and responsive states.

effectiveness.baseline: The server-rendered header linked directly to /search, while /search was vacation-specific and the attractions route did not identify its own navigation item as active.
effectiveness.target: Zero unintended URL changes when opening the header chooser, one active current-world item, and successful navigation to every listed world.
